bari shaan hai uss zaat ki jiss ney apney banday per haq o batil ka faisla ker-denay wali yeh kitab nazil ki , takay woh duniya jahan kay logon  ko khabrdar kerday .

woh zaat jo aasmano aur zameen ki badshahat ki tanha malik hai aur jiss ney naa to koi beta banaya hai , aur naa uss ki badshahat mein koi shareek hai , aur jiss ney her cheez ko peda ker kay uss ko aik napa tula andaz ata kiya hai .

aur logon  ney ussay chorr ker aesay khuda bana rakhay hain jo kuch peda nahi kertay , balkay khud peda kiye jatay hain , aur jinn ka khud apney nuqsan ya faeeday per bhi koi bus nahi chalta , aur naa kissi ka marna ya jeena unn kay ikhtiyar mein hai , naa kissi ko dobara zinda kerna .

aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  yeh ( Quran ) to kuch bhi nahi , bus aik mann gharrat cheez hai jo iss shaks ney gharr li hai , aur iss kaam mein kuch aur log bhi uss kay madadgaar banay hain .    iss tarah ( yeh baat keh ker ) yeh log baray zulm aur khulay jhoot per utar aaye hain .
aur kehtay hain kay :  yeh to pichlay logon  ki likhi hoi kahaniyan hain jo iss shaks ney likhwali hain , aur subha o shaam wohi iss kay samney parh ker sunai jati hain .
keh do kay :  yeh kalam to uss ( Allah ) ney nazil kiya hai jo her bhed ko poori tarah janta hai , aasmano mein bhi , zameen mein bhi . beyshak woh boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

aur yeh kehtay hain kay :  yeh kaisa Rasool hai jo khana bhi khata hai , aur bazaron mein bhi chalta phirta hai ? iss kay paas koi farishta kiyon nahi bheja gaya jo iss kay sath reh ker logon  ko darata-?

ya iss kay oopper koi khazana hi aa-parta , ya iss kay paas koi baagh hota jiss mein say yeh khaya kerta .  aur yeh zalim ( musalmanon say ) kehtay hain kay :  tum jiss kay peechay chal rahey ho , woh aur kuch nahi , bus aik shaks hai jiss per jadoo hogaya hai .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) dekho inn logon  ney tumharay baaray mein kaisi kaisi baaten banai hain , chunacheh aesay bhatkay hain kay raastay per aana inn kay bus say bahir hai .

bari shaan hai uss ( Allah ) ki jo agar chahye to tumhen inn sabb say kahen behtar cheez , ( aik baagh kay bajaye ) boht say baaghaat deydey jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon , aur tumhen boht say mehalaat ka malik bana dey .
asal haqeeqat yeh hai kay inn logon  ney qayamat ki gharri ko jhutlaya huwa hai ,   aur jo koi qayamat ki gharri ko jhutlaye , uss kay liye hum ney bharakti hoi aag tayyar ker rakhi hai .
jab woh unn ko door say dekhay gi to yeh log uss kay bipharney aur phunkarney ki aawazen sunen gay .
aur jab inn ko achi tarah baandh ker uss ki aik tang jagah mein phenka jaye ga to wahan yeh moat ko aawaz dey ker pukaren gay .
. ( uss waqt inn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aaj tum moat ko sirf aik baar naa pukaro , balkay baar baar moat ko pukartay hi raho .
kaho kay yeh anjam behtar hai ya hamesha rehney wali jannat , jiss ka wada muttaqi logon  say kiya gaya hai-? woh unn kay liye inaam hogi , aur unn ka aakhri anjam .
wahan unhen hamesha hamesha bastay huye her woh cheez milay gi jo woh chahen gay . yeh woh zimma daraana wada hai jo tumharay rab ney apney oopper lazim kerliya hai .

aur woh din ( enhen yaad dilao ) jab Allah inn ( kafiron ) ko bhi hashar mein jama keray ga aur unn ( maboodon ) ko bhi jinn ki yeh khuda ko chorr ker ibadat kertay thay , aur ( inn kay maboodon say ) kahey ga kay :  kiya tum ney meray inn bandon ko behkaya tha , ya yeh raastay say khud bhatkay thay-?

woh kahen gay kay :  aap ki zaat her aeb say pak hai . humari majal nahi thi kay hum aap ko chorr ker doosray rakhwalon kay qaeel hon ,   lekin huwa yeh kay aap ney inn ko aur inn kay baap dadon ko duniya ka saz-o-saman diya , yahan tak kay jo baat yaad rakhni thi , yeh ussay bhula bethay , aur ( iss tarah ) yeh khud barbad ho ker rahey .

lo , ( aey kafiro ! ) enhon ney to tumhari woh sari baaten jhutla den jo tum kaha kertay ho . abb naa ( azab ko ) taalna tumharay bus mein hai , naa koi madad hasil kerna . aur tum mein say jo koi zulm ka murtakib hai , hum ussay baray bhari azab ka maza chakhayen gay .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tum say pehlay jitney payghumber bhejay , woh sabb aesay thay kay khana bhi khatay thay , aur bazaron mein bhi chaltay phirtay thay , aur hum ney tum logon  ko aik doosray ki aazmaesh ka zariya banaya hai . batao kiya sabar kero gay-?   aur tumhara perwerdigar her baat dekh raha hai .

jinn logon  ko yeh tawaqqo hi nahi hai kay woh ( kissi waqt ) hum say aa-milen gay , woh yun kehtay hain kay :  hum per farishtay kiyon nahi utaray jatay-? ya phir aisa kiyon nahi hota kay hum khud apney perwerdigar ko dekh len-?  haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh apney dilon mein apney aap ko boht bara samjhay huye hain ,   aur enhon ney bari sarkashi ikhtiyar ki hoi hai .
jiss din inn ko farishtay nazar aagaye , uss din inn mujrimon kay liye koi khushi ka moaqa nahi hoga , balkay yeh kehtay phiren gay kay khudaya ! hamen aesi panah dey kay yeh hum say door hojayen .
aur enhon ney ( duniya mein ) jo amal kiye hain , hum unn ka faisla kernay per ayen gay to enhen fizza mein bikhray huye gard o ghubar ( ki tarah bey qeemat ) bana den gay .
uss din jannati log hon gay jinn ka mustaqar bhi behtareen hoga , aur aaram gaah bhi khoob hogi .
aur jiss din aasman phatt ker aik badal ko raah dey ga , aur farishtay iss tarah utaray jayen gay kay unn ka taar bandh jaye ga .
uss din sahih maani mein badshahi khudaye rehman ki hogi , aur woh din kafiron per boht sakht hoga .
aur jiss din zalim insan ( hasrat say ) apney haathon ko kaat khaye ga , aur kahey ga :  kaash mein ney payghumber ki hamraahi ikhtiyar kerli hoti !
haaye meri barbadi ! kaash mein ney falan shaks ko dost naa banaya hota !
meray paas naseehat aa-chuki thi , magar iss ( dost ) ney mujhay uss say bhatka diya .  aur shetan to hai hi aisa kay waqt parrney per insan ko bey kass chorr jata hai .
aur Rasool ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) kahen gay kay :  ya rab ! meri qoam iss Quran ko bilkul chorr bethi thi .
aur hum ney issi tarah mujrim logon  ko her nabi ka dushman banaya hai .   aur tumhara perwerdigar hidayat denay aur madad kernay kay liye kafi hai .

aur yeh kafir log kehtay hain kay :  inn per sara Quran aik hi dafa mein kiyon nazil nahi kerdiya gaya-?  ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney aisa iss liye kiya hai takay iss kay zariye tumhara dil mazboot rakhen ,   aur hum ney issay thehar thehar ker parhwaya hai .
aur jab kabhi yeh log tumharay paas koi anokhi baat ley ker aatay hain , hum tumhen ( uss ka ) theek theek jawab aur ziyada wazahat kay sath ata ker-detay hain .
jinn logon  ko gher ker mun kay ball dozakh ki taraf ley jaya jaye ga , woh bad-tareen maqam per hain , aur unn ka raasta bad-tareen gumrahi ka raasta hai .
beyshak hum ney musa ko kitab di thi , aur unn kay sath unn kay bhai Haroon ko madadgaar kay tor per muqarrar kiya tha .
chunacheh hum ney kaha tha kay :  tum dono unn logon  kay paas jao jinhon ney humari nishaniyon ko jhutlaya hai .  aakhir nateeja yeh huwa kay hum ney unn ko tabah ker kay neest o na-bood kerdiya .

aur nooh ki qoam ney jab payghumberon ko jhutlaya to hum ney unhen gharq kerdiya , aur unn ko logon  kay liye ibrat ka saman bana diya . aur hum ney unn zalimon kay liye aik dardnak azab tayyar ker rakha hai .
issi tarah hum ney aad o samood aur ashaab-ur-Rass   ko aur unn kay darmiyan boht si naslon ko tabah kiya .
unn mein say her aik ko samjhaney kay liye hum ney misalen den , aur ( jab woh naa maaney to ) her aik ko hum ney pees ker rakh diya .

aur yeh ( kuffaar-e-makkah ) uss basti say ho ker guzartay rahey hain jiss per buri tarah ( pathraon ki ) barish barsai gaee thi .   bhala kiya yeh uss basti ko dekhtay nahi rahey-? ( phir bhi enhen ibrat nahi hoi ) balkay inn kay dil mein doosri zindagi ka andesha tak peda nahi huwa .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab yeh log tumhen dekhtay hain to inn ka koi kaam iss kay siwa nahi hota kay yeh tumhara mazaq banatay hain kay :  kiya yehi woh sahab hain jinhen Allah ney payghumber bana ker bheja hai ?

agar hum apney khudaon ( ki aqeedat ) per mazbooti say jamay naa rehtay to inn sahab ney to hamen unn say bhatkaney mein koi kasar nahi chorri thi .  ( jo log yeh baaten keh rahey hain ) jab unhen azab aankhon say nazar aajaye ga tab unhen pata chalay ga kay kon raastay say bilkul bhatka huwa tha-?
bhala batao jiss shaks ney apna khuda apni nafsani khuwaish ko bana liya ho , to ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tum uss ki zimma daari ley saktay ho-?
ya tumhara khayal yeh hai kay inn mein say aksar log suntay ya samajhtay hain-? nahi ! inn ki misal to bus chaar paon kay janweron ki si hai , balkay yeh unn say ziyada raah say bhatkay huye hain .

kiya tum ney apney perwerdigar ( ki qudrat ) ko nahi dekha kay woh kiss tarah saye ko phelata hai-? aur agar woh chahta to ussay aik jagah thehra deta . phir hum ney sooraj ko uss kay liye rehnuma bana diya hai .
phir hum ussay thora thora ker kay apni taraf samett letay hain .
aur wohi hai jiss ney tumharay liye raat ko libas banaya , aur neend ko sarapa sukoon , aur din ko dobara uth kharray honey ka zariya bana diya .
aur wohi hai jiss ney apni rehmat ( yani barish ) say pehlay hawayen bhejen jo ( barish ki ) khushkhabri ley ker aati hain , aur hum ney hi aasman say pakeezah paani utaara hai ,
takay hum uss kay zariye murda zameen ko zindagi bakhshen , aur apni makhlooq mein say boht say maweshiyon aur insanon ko uss say sairaab keren .
aur hum ney logon  kay faeeday kay liye uss ( paani ) ki ulat pher ker rakhi hai ,   takay woh sabaq hasil keren . lekin aksar log nashukri kay siwa her baat say inkari hain .
aur agar hum chahtay to her basti mein aik alag aagah kernay wala ( payghumber ) bhej detay .
lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn kafiron ka kehna naa maano , aur iss Quran kay zariye unn kay khilaf poori quooat say jidojehad kero .

aur wohi hai jiss ney do daryaon ko iss tarah mila ker chalaya hai kay aik meetha hai jiss say taskeen milti hai , aur aik namkeen hai , sakht karrwa . aur inn dono kay darmiyan aik aarr aur aesi rukawat haeel kerdi hai jiss ko ( dono mein say ) koi uboor nahi ker-sakta .
aur wohi hai jiss ney paani say insan ko peda kiya , phir uss ko nasbi aur susrali rishtay ata kiye , aur tumhara perwerdigar bari qudrat wala hai .

aur yeh log hain kay Allah ko chorr ker aesi cheezon ki ibadat ker rahey hain jo naa inn ko koi faeeda phonchati hain , naa nuqsan . aur kafir insan ney apney perwerdigar hi ki mukhalifat per kamar baandh rakhi hai .
aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen kissi aur kaam kay liye nahi , balkay iss liye bheja hai kay tum logon  ko khushkhabri do , aur khabrdar kero .
keh do kay :  mein iss kaam per tum say koi ujrat nahi maangta , haan jo shaks yeh chahye kay apney rab tak phonchney ka raasta ikhtiyar kerlay ( to yehi meri ujrat hai )

aur tum uss zaat per bharosa rakho jo zinda hai , jissay kabhi moat nahi aaye gi , aur ussi ki hamd kay sath tasbeeh kertay raho , aur woh apney bandon kay gunahon ki khabar rakhney kay liye kafi hai .

woh zaat jiss ney cheh din mein saray aasman aur zameen aur unn kay darmiyan ki cheezen peda ken, phir uss ney arsh per istawa farmaya ,   woh rehman hai , iss liye uss ki shaan kissi janney walay say poocho .

aur jab inn logon  say kaha jata hai kay rehman ko sajda kero to yeh kehtay hain kay :  rehman kiya hota hai-? kiya jissay bhi tum keh do , hum ussay sajda kiya keren-?    aur iss baat say woh aur ziyada bidakney lagtay hain .
bari shaan hai uss ki jiss ney aasman mein burj banaye .   aur uss mein aik roshan chiragh aur noor phelaney wala chaand peda kiya .

aur wohi hai jiss ney raat aur din ko aisa banaya kay woh aik doosray kay peechay chalay aatay hain , ( magar yeh sari baaten ) uss shaks kay liye ( kaar-aamad hain ) jo naseehat hasil kernay ka irada rakhta ho ya shukar baja lana chahta ho .
aur rehman kay banday woh hain jo zameen per aajzi say chaltay hain , aur jab jahil log unn say ( jahilana ) khitab kertay hain to woh salamti ki baat kehtay hain .
aur jo raaten iss tarah guzaartay hain kay apney perwerdigar kay aagay ( kabhi ) sajday mein hotay hain , aur ( kabhi ) qayam mein .
aur jo yeh kehtay hain kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! jahannum kay azab ko hum say door rakhiye . haqeeqat yeh hai kay uss ka azab woh tabahi hai jo chimat ker reh jati hai .
yaqeenan woh kissi ka mustaqar aur qayam gaah banney kay liye bad-tareen jagah hai .
aur jo kharch kertay hain to naa fuzool kharchi kertay hain , naa tangi kertay hain , balkay unn ka tareeqa iss ( ifraat o tafreet ) kay darmiyan aetidaal ka tareeqa hai .

aur jo Allah kay sath kissi bhi doosray mabood ki ibadat nahi kertay , aur jiss jaan ko Allah ney hurmat bakhshi hai , ussay nahaq qatal nahi kertay , aur naa woh zina kertay hain . aur jo shaks bhi yeh kaam keray ga , ussay apney gunah kay wabal ka samna kerna parray ga .
qayamat kay din uss ka azab barha barha ker dugna kerdiya jaye ga , aur woh zaleel ho ker uss azab mein hamesha hamesha rahey ga .
haan magar jo koi tauba kerlay , emaan ley aaye , aur naik amal keray to Allah aesay logon  ki buraiyon ko naikiyon mein tabdeel kerday ga ,   aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
aur jo koi tauba kerta aur naik amal kerta hai to woh dar-haqeeqat Allah ki taraf theek theek loat aata hai .
aur ( rehman kay banday woh hain ) jo nahaq kamon mein shamil nahi hotay ,   aur jab kissi laghw cheez kay paas say guzartay hain to waqar kay sath guzar jatay hain .
aur jab unhen apney rab ki aayaat kay zariye naseehat ki jati hai to woh unn per behray aur andhay ban ker nahi girtay .
aur jo ( dua kertay huye ) kehtay hain kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! hamen apni biwi bacchon say aankhon ki thandak ata farma , aur hamen perhezgaron ka sarbarah bana dey .
yeh log hain jinhen unn kay sabar kay badlay jannat kay bala-khaney ata hon gay , aur wahan duaon aur salam say unn ka istaqbal kiya jaye ga .
woh wahan hamesha zinda rahen gay . kissi ka mustaqar aur qayam gaah banney kay liye woh behtareen jagah hai .

. ( aey payghumber ! logon  say ) keh do kay :  meray perwerdigar ko tumhari zara bhi perwa naa hoti , agar tum uss ko naa pukartay .   abb jabkay ( aey kafiro ! ) tum ney haq ko jhutla diya hai to yeh jhutlana tumharay galay parr ker rahey ga .
